Board Meeting Intimation for CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF UNAUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED 30TH SEPTEMBER 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Premier Polyfilm Limited reported a robust financial performance for the fiscal year 2025-2026, with net profit surging to ₹3,188 lakhs and revenue from operations reaching ₹33,890 lakhs. Operational efficiency improved as production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products grew to 29,311 metric tonnes, supported by enhanced capacity utilization from newly commissioned plant and machinery. Management focused on strategic cost and margin management by procuring raw materials competitively, maintaining stable selling prices, and discontinuing sub-optimal product lines. Additionally, the company acquired an 18.13-acre industrial plot in Tamil Nadu, commenced logistics and trading activities there, and placed an order for new manufacturing machinery expected to commence commercial production soon. This document is the Annual Report of Premier Polyfilm Limited for the financial year 2020-2021, containing notice of the 33rd Annual General Meeting, details of ordinary and special business items, and information regarding board members, auditors, and executive remuneration.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's products continue to be in demand as a result of R&D efforts.
demand_outlook.quote: By introducing above R&D formulations has helped the company to reduce cost of new range of colour schemes and designs of finished products the Company’s products continue to be in demand.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has secured and taken possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has secured and taken possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and that the Company has commenced logistics and trading activities at the new unit and the billing process has also started.

capex_expansion.claim: The company placed an order for manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine with advance payment made.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company has placed an order for manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine and the advance payment for the same has been made.

capex_expansion.claim: The company installed and utilized new plant and machinery to achieve higher capacity utilization.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company achieved higher capacity utilization with the installation and utilization of new Plant & Machinery.

margins_costs.claim: The company implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.
margins_costs.quote: The Company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.

margins_costs.claim: The company strategically discontinued product lines with sub-optimal margins to concentrate on high-demand, high-profitability categories.
margins_costs.quote: This was complemented by the strategic discontinuation of product lines with sub-optimal margins, allowing for a concentrated focus on high-demand, high-profitability categories.

margins_costs.claim: The increase in cash profit was primarily due to arranging raw material at a cheaper rate while keeping finished goods sales prices unchanged.
margins_costs.quote: The reasons for increase in cash profit during the current quarter and year ended on 31st March,2024 was mainly due to that company could arrange raw material at cheaper rate and sold the finished goods at existing sales prices i.e. the prices of finished goods were not changed/devalued.

margins_costs.claim: Production of certain low-profit finished goods items was stopped.
margins_costs.quote: Secondly productions of some of the items of finished goods which were not generated good profits were stopped and to some extent company could arrange cheaper loan from other bank i.e. Yes Bank Limited and hence finance cost was also reduced.

orders_capacity.claim: Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products grew to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational excellence was a key highlight, with production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products growing to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.

orders_capacity.claim: The production increase resulted from enhanced capacity utilization following the successful commissioning of new plant and machinery.
orders_capacity.quote: This increase is a direct result of enhanced capacity utilization following the successful commissioning of new plant and machinery during the year, which has strengthened our manufacturing capabilities.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the company produced 27,133 M.T. of PVC flooring, sheetings, films, etc.
orders_capacity.quote: During the period under review your company produced 27,133 M.T. of PVC flooring, Sheetings, Films etc. as against 26,755 M.T. produced during the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: The board transferred an amount of Rs. 400/- Lakh to General Reserves during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board has transferred an amount of Rs. 400/- Lakh to General Reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of 15% (Rs. 0.15 per equity share of Rs. 1/-) for the financial year 2025-2026.
capital_allocation.quote: “RESOLVED THAT a dividend of 15% (Rs.0.15 per equity share of Rs. 1/-) as recommended by the Board of Directors be and is hereby declared out of the profits of the Company for the financial year 2025-2026.”

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 15% amounting to Rs. 0.75 per equity share of Rs. 5 each for the year ended March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: Encouraged by the performance of the company, The Board of your company is pleased to recommend for your approval Payment of dividend @ 0.75 per equity share of Rs.5/- each (i.e. 15%) for the year ended on 31st March,2024 subject to deduction of Tax at Source

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved the sub-division of existing equity shares from a face value of Rs. 5 per share to Rs. 1 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors at their meeting held on 17th May, 2024 considered and approved the proposal of restructuring the Share Capital of the Company by sub-dividing the existing equity shares into face value of Rs. 1/- per share in place of Rs. 5/- per share.

risks_headwinds.claim: Lower profitability in the company was attributed to economic slowdown and adverse market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to economic slowdown and consequent adverse market conditions prevailing, there was lower profitability in the Company.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production through the newly ordered PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.
management_commitments.quote: The commercial production through the said machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to fully switch to other sustainable and renewable sources of power and energy such as solar and PNG energy during the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Seeing the Government inclination towards pollution free environment and as per various notifications of Government in this regard,your Company plans to fully switch other sustainable and renewable sources of power/energy such as Solar and PNG energy inaddition to available current source of power energy available with the company during the current financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company continues to develop economical formulations for production.
management_commitments.quote: The Company continues to develop economical formulations for production. The company will consider future plan based on need and availability of funds.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
